title: 第1章 诡异穿越第2章 兵符空间
content_zh:
第一章 诡异穿越
冷，刺骨的冷。让熟睡中的郭飞禁不住打了个寒颤，悠悠醒来，睁开了朦胧的双眼。
黄沙千里，残阳如血。诡异的天空，一侧灰蒙蒙的，没有一丝阳光；另一侧，如血的残阳无力的挂在天边，淡淡的血色光芒泛出丝丝冷意。
郭飞看了一下自己，躺在沙坑中，上半身在残阳的斜照下，下半身在朦胧的黑暗中。
这么诡异的地方如何会出现，随即不禁哑然失笑，心中暗自道：“肯定是在做梦了，玩游戏入迷了，都出现怪异的梦境了！”
郭飞是师范大学历史系大一的新生，三天前学校放假，众多室友都急匆匆的回家团聚了，郭飞没有回去，自从父母离异，母亲去了美国，父亲找个比自己大不了多少的后妈后，那个家已经没有了往日的感觉。
郭飞感觉自己是个多余的人，曾经的优等生，成绩一落千丈，只考了个普通的师范院校。如果不是想离开家独立生活，才发奋了半年，郭飞没有上大学的希望。
两年来，游戏消磨着他无聊的时间，娱乐着他悲伤的心绪。
进入大学，郭飞决定自己要独立起来，努力奋斗。
由于学习紧张，没有空闲时间玩游戏。最近上市的《三国群英传8》，据说是在《三国群英传7》里面加了点补丁制作的，不管怎么样，郭飞早就惦记上了。
放假后，室友离去，游戏的瘾终于可以解决了。
郭飞将自己锁在宿舍，玩了三天三夜，几乎要通关了，才耐不住困乏，趴在桌上睡着了。睡梦中似乎听见有人大叫“风暴！”，并听见呼呼的响声，想来肯定是梦。
“沙沙沙……。”一阵嘈杂的声音传来，郭飞感到更加的阴冷，身体不停的发抖，胡思乱想着，想让自己赶快从梦中醒来。
再次揉揉眼，依然是这片天空。
顺着发出声音的地方看去。郭飞汗毛头发都竖了起来。顺着层层叠叠的沙丘，来了一队骷髅。郭飞再次揉揉眼睛，仔细看，是的，确实是骷髅。
当前一个骷髅，头上戴着一个破铜盔，后面跟着至少有上百个骷髅，骨骼纯白锃亮，关节连接紧密。
他们押送着十几个普通人，这些人穿着粗布麻衣，长长的头发束了起来，倒像是电视上看到的殷商时期的人。
这些人畏畏缩缩的不愿意往前走，这些骷髅时不时的用剑把猛砸，害的这些人一阵的疼叫，步履瞬间加快了一点。
郭飞仔细观看，这些骷髅行动快如灵猿，手中各自拿着一把骨刀，最前面的还拿着一个破盾，看不出什么材质。
“啪！”郭飞狠狠的打了自己一个耳光。

疼、无比的疼。“娘呀！这不是梦！”
梦醒了，震惊了。郭飞下意识的将头低了下去，将身体压在沙坑中。扭头左右查看，自己所在的位置是一个沙丘顶部的浅浅的沙坑中，身上依然穿着自己的灰色大裤头和白色的背心，背心上面落了一层沙尘，变得土黄土黄的，脚上没有穿鞋子。
郭飞回忆一下，在宿舍中确实是光脚的。空气中远不是自己所在世界的七月份，骄阳如火，酷热难耐。而是冷冰冰的凉意不住的传来，似乎是深秋的温度。
“咦！”郭飞身体扭动间，发现了一个硬硬的物件顶在自己的腰肢上，顺手拉了出来。
一个巴掌大小，厚度约两厘米的，类似令牌的东西。材质似金非金、似铜非铜、似玉非玉，上面绣着古朴的花纹，在花纹中有几个图形一下子吸引了郭飞的眼光，竟然是《三国群英传8》中的兵种造型。仔细辨认下，看出是骑兵、剑兵、刺客、舞娘和尸兵。
五个图形按照正方形的方位排列在四角，围拢着中间两个汉字：“兵符！”，其中兵符两字压着一个兵种印记。
“是汉字！”郭飞一怔，下意识的想到了一个问题，这可能是自己迷失在这个空间的原因，顿时紧紧的抓在了手中，能不能回去就要看这个兵符了。
郭飞顾不得仔细的看，因为他发现，这些骷髅队伍竟然朝着自己的沙丘方向过来了，一旦他们到达这里，自己将无所遁形。
“跑！”这是郭飞的第一反应。身体瞬间弹起，下意识的朝沙丘右侧的光明区域奔去。
沙子搁着脚，一阵钻心的疼。郭飞从小生活在殷实的家庭，父亲身价千万，哪里吃过这样的苦，但此时也顾不得那么多了，连滚带爬，只顾逃命。
“沙、沙、沙！”骷髅队伍一下子发现了郭飞，领头的骷髅单指一点，一个骷髅瞬间飞驰而来，朝郭飞追去。这个骷髅快如灵猿，几个呼吸间就挡在了郭飞的面前。
郭飞顿时有股晕倒的感觉，近前细看才发现，这个骷髅两个黑洞洞的眼眶中各镶嵌着一块不规则的晶块，晶块发出暗红的光芒，这两道光芒如同眼睛一样，正死死的盯着郭飞。
骷髅骨刀一闪，刀把撞击在郭飞的胸部，一下子将郭飞打的倒翻了出去，钻心的疼痛传遍了全身，随后骷髅指了指后面的队伍，示意郭飞随他们走。
郭飞下意识的将手中兵符握紧，心中极度的害怕这个骷髅会抢。这可是自己回去的唯一希望了。
“砰！”骷髅兵嫌郭飞动作太慢，手掌一挥，干瘪的骨爪抓住郭飞的大裤头，一扬手将其扔出三米远，郭飞顺着沙丘滚到了骷髅队伍前。
“妈妈的，好大的力气！”郭飞又一次震惊了。赶紧将大裤头拉上，遮盖住隐秘处。
这是哪里，我要去什么地方，难道是地狱，难道我死了！眩晕的郭飞禁不住内心极度的拷问着。
“踏踏踏……”一阵急促的踏步声传来，骷髅兵顿时紧张了起来，领头的骷髅头领一挥骨刀，百十个骷髅兵瞬间列成两队，拦住了后面的去路。
沙丘后面尘土飞扬，转瞬间，一队全身甲胄的骑兵队伍随着朦朦胧胧的沙尘，如同神兵天降。
清一色的高头大马、手中各自擎着一把精钢长斧，斧头上面闪着清冷的亮光。

骑兵在尘雾中疾驰，转瞬间冲向了骷髅队伍。“砰！”当前一名骑士斧头重重的砍下，准确的将一个骷髅的脑袋砸碎。
另一名骑士瞬间也冲了过来，举起斧头向一个骷髅砍去，骷髅闪避不及，被砸碎了脊柱，骷髅双爪依然扒拉着沙子拼命的想逃走，骑士将马一提，马蹄踏在骷髅的头顶上，脑壳中迸出两粒暗红色的晶块，晶块红芒一闪，消散了，露出了蓝莹莹的本体，骷髅瞬间不动了。
郭飞有点发懵，呆呆的看着混战的场面，脑海中一片空白，不知所措。
“咔咔！”骷髅头领嘴巴一张一合，发出不规则的响声。这些骷髅不再恋战，开始奔逃，路过俘虏的时候，骨刀顺势刺出，将带出来的俘虏刺死。
“哧！”一名骷髅朝郭飞刺来，郭飞下意识的闪避一下，骨刀划过手臂，拉出了一条长长的血口，顿时血流如注，骷髅看郭飞躲过，骨刀一收一送，接着刺来。
“砰！”一道尖利的啸声，一个蓝莹莹的冰箭旋转着撞在了骨刀上面，将骷髅的骨刀撞的斜在一边，骷髅不再攻击郭飞，扭头逃窜。
郭飞仰头一看，队伍后面一女子骑白马疾驰而来，此人一袭碧蓝长袍，青丝飞扬，云鬓高耸，上面系着一个蓝色的珠冠，闪着璀璨的光芒。
近前看，小口如樱桃，皓齿如银雪、娇容如温玉，手中一个碧蓝手杖，尖部镶嵌着一个蓝莹莹的拳头大小的珠子，温文尔雅宛如仙女下凡。
“神仙！”郭飞大惊，眼中露出了不可思议的诧异。难道这就是仙术，我到了什么地方。如果不是刚才遇到骷髅，郭飞此时恐怕认为此人就是仙女了。
“死奴隶，看什么看！”一声厉喝，在女子身边的枣红马上端坐一名男子，男子约双十年龄，一身白色的铠甲，紧紧的裹住伟岸的身躯；再往上看，唇红齿白，颇为英俊，头戴一个银色的钢盔，显得英姿飒爽。
此人看郭飞怔怔的看着女子，顿时大怒，一拉缰绳，马向前一窜，此人右腿顺势一摆，将郭飞踢得横飞了出去，顿时昏倒在地。
“太剽悍了！”这是郭飞昏迷前唯一的一个念头。
此人怒气未消，一提马缰，手中长柄斧朝郭飞的头部砍去。
“住手！”女子赶紧制止道。
“姐姐，一个奴隶，对你如此无礼，杀就杀了吧！”男子看到女子阻止，顿时脸上露出了一丝不耐，嘟囔道。
“弟弟，你该改改你的性子。你看此人没有我们赵家的‘奴印’，而且身体细白，不像是经常劳作的人，不可妄动杀念。”
“嗯，一个手无缚鸡之力、身体如此孱弱的废物而已。此地已经是鬼蜮边缘了，马上天黑了，我们要马上离开，一旦鬼族高手过来，就危险了。”赵霸不耐的冷哼一声，冷冷的看着郭飞道，明显要把郭飞留在此地。
“尊贵的郡主，把他留下恐怕很快就被鬼族抢走，岂不是又给鬼族贡献了一个矿工，我看不如让老奴带回去吧。”旁边唯一一个没有被骷髅兵杀死的俘虏朝前几步道。
其实，郭飞在昏迷的瞬间就被胳膊的伤疼醒了，他震惊的是这些人的对话他竟然听的懂，这语言类似中国的古语。
难道我回到了古代的中国，难道这是异时空和电子空间变异造成的，让郭飞彻底懵懂了。

“他昏迷着，你来背负他么？”赵霸嘴一撇道。
老者走到郭飞身边，拉了拉郭飞，郭飞缓慢的站了起来。此时，郭飞想的不是生死问题，而是手中的令牌不见了，就在血液流入掌心令牌的瞬间，掌心一热，令牌就消失了。
郭飞偷眼向四周查看，同时还害怕别人发现，这些人一个个剽悍异常，要是抢自己，自己根本没有还手之力。
心中想着令牌，顿时手心又热了起来，郭飞一看，手掌中多了一个印记，正是那个令牌的样子，竟然化作了印记融入了手掌中。
怪异的事情太多了，郭飞已经麻木了，既然在自己手掌心，就安心了。随即不再考虑，转眼看向四周。
骑兵已经停止追逃进入黑暗区域的骷髅，在杀死骷髅的脑壳中将蓝莹莹的晶块一粒粒的取出来、收起。
老者看了郭飞一眼，将死去几个俘虏的粗布麻衣和草鞋脱下来，给郭飞递过来。
郭飞虽然感到恶心，但寒冷促使他迅速的穿上了粗布麻衣，套上了草鞋。并感激的朝老者点点头。
老者微微一笑，披散的头发露出了洁白的牙齿，在其半边脸上有着一个巨大的烙印，郭飞不认识，但知道这肯定就是奴印了。
随后，老者撕了一条布带，准备替郭飞包扎一下伤口。长长的伤口不住的流血，让郭飞感到很疼痛。
“闪开！”赵雪对老者一指道。
老者一愣，随即闪开。郭飞懵懂的看着这个漂亮的女子，不知道她什么意思。
只见此女子将手中的碧玉杖对准郭飞的伤口，其顶部的一个蓝色的，如同拳头大小的透明晶体一阵闪耀，随着女子手杖的划动，上面发出一道水蓝色的光芒，射在了郭飞的伤口上。
郭飞感到伤口一凉，一阵麻酥酥的感觉，伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合了，竟然没有留下一丝伤痕。
“感谢小郡主！”老者赶紧代郭飞躬身感谢道。
“一个臭奴隶，值得姐姐用灵气为其疗伤么！”旁边的赵霸嘟囔一句，看向郭飞的眼神更加的阴狠。
“呵呵。弟弟，你要改改你性子，杀心如此重，当心入魔！”赵雪嫣然一笑道。
郭飞怔了怔，纵然见过许多美女，此时也不禁被她吸引了，此女子是个极有魅力的人。旁边的骑兵也都怔怔的看着她，一时间都沉迷了进去。
“回营！”赵霸左右一看，脸色一变，冷喝一声，骑兵迅速的组成两列纵队，将郭飞和老者围在中间，缓慢的朝前走去。

Chapter 1 Weird time travel
Cold, biting cold. Guo Fei, who was sleeping soundly, couldn't help but shudder. Youyou woke up and opened his hazy eyes.
The yellow sand is thousands of miles away, and the setting sun is like blood. One side of the strange sky was gray and without a trace of sunlight; on the other side, the blood-like setting sun hung feebly on the horizon, with a faint blood-colored light giving off a hint of coldness.
Guo Fei took a look at himself, lying in the sand pit, his upper body under the slanting light of the setting sun, and his lower body in the hazy darkness.
How could such a weird place appear? I couldn't help but burst into laughter, and said to myself: "I must be dreaming. I'm obsessed with playing games, and I have weird dreams!"
Guo Fei is a freshman in the history department of the Normal University. The school was on holiday three days ago, and many of his roommates hurriedly went home to reunite. Guo Fei did not go back. Since his parents divorced, his mother went to the United States, and his father found a stepmother who was not much older than him, the home no longer had the same feeling as before.
Guo Fei felt that he was a redundant person. He was once a top student, but his grades plummeted and he only got into an ordinary normal college. If he hadn't worked hard for half a year to leave home and live independently, Guo Fei would have no hope of going to college.
For two years, games killed his boring time and entertained his sad mood.
After entering college, Guo Fei decided to become independent and work hard.
Due to intense study, I have no free time to play games. The recently launched "Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 8" is said to be made with some patches added to "Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 7". In any case, Guo Fei has long been thinking about it.
After the holidays, my roommates left, and my gaming addiction was finally resolved.
Guo Fei locked himself in the dormitory and played for three days and three nights. He was almost finished the game before he couldn't bear the sleepiness and fell asleep on the table. In my sleep, I seemed to hear someone shouting "Storm!" and a whirring sound. I guess it must be a dream.
"Shashasha..." A noisy sound came, and Guo Fei felt even colder, his body kept shaking, and he was thinking wildly, hoping to wake up from his dream as soon as possible.
Rubbing his eyes again, it was still this sky.
Look where the sound is coming from. Guo Fei's hair and hair stood on end. Along the layers of sand dunes, a group of skeletons came. Guo Fei rubbed his eyes again and looked carefully. Yes, it was indeed a skeleton.
The first skeleton wore a broken copper helmet on its head, followed by at least hundreds of skeletons. The bones were pure white and shiny, and the joints were tightly connected.
They were escorting a dozen ordinary people. These people were dressed in coarse linen clothes and had their long hair tied up. They looked more like the people from the Yin and Shang Dynasties seen on TV.
These people were cowering and unwilling to move forward. From time to time, these skeletons would hit them with their sword handles, causing these people to scream in pain and their steps would speed up in an instant.
Guo Fei watched carefully and saw that these skeletons moved as fast as apes, each holding a bone knife in their hands, and the one at the front also held a broken shield. No material could be seen.
"Pah!" Guo Fei slapped himself hard.
It hurts, it hurts so much. "Mom! This is not a dream!"
I woke up from the dream, shocked. Guo Fei lowered his head subconsciously and pressed his body into the sand pit. He turned around and looked around. He was in a shallow sand pit on the top of a sand dune. He was still wearing his gray pants and white vest. A layer of dust fell on the vest, making it khaki. He had no shoes on his feet.
Guo Fei recalled that he was indeed barefoot in the dormitory. The air in the air was far from July in my own world. The sun was like fire and the heat was unbearable. Instead, an icy chill could not help but come, as if it was the temperature of late autumn.
"Hey!" As Guo Fei twisted his body, he found a hard object pressing against his waist and pulled it out smoothly.
Something about the size of a palm and about two centimeters thick, similar to a token. The material looks like gold but not gold, looks like copper but not copper, looks like jadeIt was not jade, with simple patterns embroidered on it. There were several figures in the patterns that immediately caught Guo Fei's attention. They turned out to be the shapes of the military units in "The Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 8". After careful identification, they were cavalry, swordsmen, assassins, dancers and corpse soldiers.
Five figures are arranged in the four corners of the square, surrounded by two Chinese characters in the middle: "Soldier Symbols!", among which the two characters "Soldier Symbols" bear the mark of a military branch.
"It's Chinese characters!" Guo Fei was startled and subconsciously thought of a question. This might be the reason why he was lost in this space. He immediately grasped it tightly in his hand. Whether he could go back would depend on this soldier talisman.
Guo Fei didn't bother to look carefully, because he discovered that these skeleton teams were coming towards his sand dune. Once they arrived here, he would have nothing to hide from.
"Run!" This was Guo Fei's first reaction. The body bounced up instantly and subconsciously ran towards the bright area on the right side of the dune.
My feet rested on the sand, and there was a heartbreaking pain. Guo Fei has lived in a wealthy family since he was a child. His father is worth tens of millions. He has never suffered such hardships. But at this time, he didn't care about so much anymore. He just rolled around and just ran for his life.
"Sand, sand, sand!" The skeleton team suddenly discovered Guo Fei. The leading skeleton pointed a single point, and a skeleton flew over instantly and chased Guo Fei. This skeleton was as fast as a spiritual ape and stood in front of Guo Fei in just a few breaths.
Guo Fei suddenly felt like fainting. When he looked closer, he discovered that the skeleton's two dark eye sockets were each inlaid with an irregular crystal block. The crystal block emitted a dark red light. These two rays of light were like eyes, staring at Guo Fei.
The skull knife flashed, and the handle of the knife hit Guo Fei's chest, knocking Guo Fei upside down. Heart-wrenching pain spread throughout his body. Then the skeleton pointed at the team behind him and motioned for Guo Fei to follow them.
Guo Fei subconsciously clenched the weapon talisman in his hand, extremely afraid that the skeleton would steal it. This is my only hope of going back.
"Bang!" The skeleton soldier thought that Guo Fei's movements were too slow. He waved his hand and grabbed Guo Fei's trousers with his withered bone claws. He raised his hand and threw him three meters away. Guo Fei rolled along the sand dune to the front of the skeleton team.
"Mom, that's so strong!" Guo Fei was shocked again. He quickly pulled up his pants to cover his secret area.
Where is this, where am I going, is it hell, is I dead! The dizzy Guo Fei couldn't help but be tortured in his heart.
"Tap tap tap..." A burst of rapid footsteps came, and the skeleton soldiers suddenly became nervous. The leading skeleton leader waved his bone knife, and a hundred skeleton soldiers instantly formed two teams, blocking the way behind.
Dust was flying behind the dunes, and in an instant, a team of cavalry in full armor followed the hazy dust, like divine soldiers descending from the sky.
The tall horses all held a long fine steel ax in their hands, with a cold light shining on the ax head.
The cavalry galloped in the dust and mist, and rushed towards the skeleton team in an instant. "Bang!" The current knight struck down hard with his axe, accurately smashing the head of a skeleton.
Another knight rushed over in an instant and raised his ax to chop at a skeleton. The skeleton was unable to dodge and its spine was smashed. The skeleton's claws were still pulling at the sand and trying desperately to escape. The knight lifted the horse and stepped on the skull's head. Two dark red crystals burst out from the skull. The crystals flashed red and dissipated, revealing the blue body. The skeleton instantly stopped moving.
Guo Fei was a little dazed, staring at the melee scene blankly, his mind went blank and he was at a loss.
"Kaka!" The skull leader opened and closed his mouth, making irregular sounds. These skeletons stopped fighting and began to run away. When passing by the captives, the bone knives stabbed out and stabbed the captives to death.
"Chi!" A skeleton stabbed at Guo Fei. Guo Fei subconsciously dodged, and the bone knife passed through his arm and pulled out aThere was a long bloody mouth, and blood suddenly flowed out. The skeleton saw Guo Fei dodge, and then retracted and sent the bone knife away, and then stabbed.
"Bang!" There was a sharp whistle, and a blue ice arrow whirled and hit the bone knife, knocking the skeleton's bone knife sideways. The skeleton stopped attacking Guo Fei and turned around to run away.
Guo Fei looked up and saw a woman galloping towards her on a white horse from the back of the team. This person was wearing a blue robe, with flying black hair, and tall temples, with a blue beaded crown tied on it, shining brightly.
Looking up close, her small mouth is like a cherry, her white teeth are like silver snow, and her face is as charming as warm jade. In her hand is a blue cane, with a blue fist-sized bead inlaid on the tip. She is as gentle and elegant as a fairy descending to earth.
"God!" Guo Fei was shocked, with incredible surprise in his eyes. Could this be magic, where have I come from? If he hadn't encountered the skeleton just now, Guo Fei might have thought that this person was a fairy.
"Damn slave, what are you looking at!" shouted a man, sitting on the maroon horse next to the woman. The man was about 20 years old, wearing white armor, tightly wrapped around his stalwart body; looking up, he had red lips and white teeth, he was quite handsome, and he wore a silver helmet on his head, which made him look heroic.
The man saw Guo Fei staring blankly at the woman and became furious. He pulled the reins and the horse jumped forward. The man swung his right leg and kicked Guo Fei away. He fell unconscious to the ground.
"Too fierce!" This was Guo Fei's only thought before he fell into coma.
The man was still angry. He picked up the reins of his horse and struck Guo Fei on the head with a long-handled ax.
"Stop!" the woman quickly stopped.
"Sister, a slave who is so rude to you, just kill him!" When the man saw the woman stopping her, a hint of impatience appeared on his face and he muttered.
"Brother, you should change your temper. You see, this person does not have the 'slave mark' of our Zhao family, and his body is thin and fair. He does not look like someone who works often. He should not act rashly or have murderous thoughts."
"Well, he's just a waste with no strength and a weak body. This place is already on the edge of ghosts. It will get dark soon. We have to leave immediately. Once the masters of the ghosts come, it will be dangerous." Zhao Ba snorted impatiently and looked at Guo Fei coldly, obviously wanting to keep Guo Fei here.
"Honorable Princess, I'm afraid if you leave him here, he will be snatched away by the ghost tribe soon. Wouldn't it be another miner for the ghost tribe? I think it's better to let the old slave take him back." The only prisoner next to him who was not killed by the skeleton soldiers walked a few steps forward.
In fact, Guo Fei was awakened by the pain in his arm the moment he was unconscious. He was shocked that he could understand the conversation of these people. The language was similar to ancient Chinese language.
Could it be that I have returned to ancient China? Could this be caused by the mutation of different time and space and electronic space? Guo Fei was completely confused.
"He is unconscious, will you carry him?" Zhao Ba curled his lips and asked.
The old man walked to Guo Fei and pulled Guo Fei. Guo Fei stood up slowly. At this moment, Guo Fei was not thinking about life and death, but that the token in his hand was missing. The moment the blood flowed into the token in his palm, the token disappeared as soon as the palm of his hand was heated.
Guo Fei looked around secretly, and at the same time he was afraid that others would find out. These people were all extremely tough. If they tried to rob him, he would not be able to fight back.
Thinking of the token in his mind, his palm suddenly became warm again. Guo Fei took a look and saw that there was an extra mark in his palm. It was exactly like the token, and it turned into a mark and blended into his palm.
There are so many weird things that Guo Fei has become numb. Now that it is in the palm of his hand, he feels at ease. Then he stopped thinking about it and looked around.
The cavalry had stopped chasing the skeletons who were escaping into the dark area. They took out and put away Lan Yingying's crystal pieces one by one from the skulls of the killed skeletons.
The old man glanced at Guo Fei, took off the coarse linen clothes and straw sandals of the dead prisoners, and handed them to Guo Fei.
Although Guo FeiHe felt sick, but the cold prompted him to quickly put on his coarse linen clothes and straw sandals. And nodded gratefully towards the old man.
The old man smiled slightly, his disheveled hair revealing his white teeth. There was a huge mark on half of his face. Guo Fei didn't recognize it, but he knew it must be the slave mark.
Then, the old man tore off a piece of cloth and prepared to bandage Guo Fei's wound. The long wound continued to bleed, making Guo Fei feel very painful.
"Get out of the way!" Zhao Xue pointed at the old man.
The old man was stunned for a moment and then moved away. Guo Fei looked at this beautiful woman in confusion, not knowing what she meant.
The woman pointed the jasper stick in her hand at Guo Fei's wound. A blue, fist-sized transparent crystal on the top shone for a while. As the woman's stick moved, a water-blue light emitted from it and hit Guo Fei's wound.
Guo Fei felt the wound become cold and numb. The wound healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, leaving no trace of scar.
"Thank you, little princess!" The old man quickly bowed and thanked Guo Fei.
"Is a stinky slave worthy of my sister using spiritual energy to heal his wounds?" Zhao Ba muttered next to him and looked at Guo Fei with an even more sinister look.
"Haha. Brother, you have to change your temper. You are so murderous, be careful of becoming possessed!" Zhao Xue said with a sweet smile.
Guo Fei was stunned. Even though he had seen many beauties, he couldn't help but be attracted to her. This woman was a very charming person. The cavalrymen next to her also looked at her blankly, and they were all fascinated for a while.
"Go back to camp!" Zhao Ba looked around, his face changed, and he shouted coldly. The cavalry quickly formed two columns, surrounded Guo Fei and the old man, and walked forward slowly.
